question: Estimate the size of the Indian gaming + esports industry by 2030.
idealClarificationQuestions: All gaming + esports + streaming revenue by 2030? Yes.
Includes RMG (real-money gaming) at current GST regime? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Game development services exports (Indian studios for global publishers): ~₹6,000 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Real-money gaming (rummy, poker, fantasy — post-28% GST realities)

calculationFlow: Real-money gaming (rummy, poker, fantasy — post-28% GST realities): ~₹20,000 Cr.
Game streaming (YouTube Gaming, Loco, Rooter): ~₹2,500 Cr.
Game development services exports (Indian studios for global publishers): ~₹6,000 Cr.
Total: ~₹73,000 Cr (~$9B) Indian gaming + esports by 2030.
